title: Sparkly envelope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='env' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD1DC'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB6C1'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Envelope body -->
  <rect x='18' y='32' width='64' height='44' rx='5' fill='#FFE4B5' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Envelope flap (triangle) -->
  <polygon points='18,32 50,56 82,32' fill='#FFD700' stroke='#FFE4B5' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Flap fold lines -->
  <line x1='18' y1='32' x2='50' y2='56' stroke='#FFA500' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='82' y1='32' x2='50' y2='56' stroke='#FFA500' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Heart seal -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='5' fill='#FF69B4' stroke='#FF1493' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M50 53.5 C48.5 51.5, 45.5 52.5, 46.5 55 L50 58 L53.5 55 C54.5 52.5, 51.5 51.5, 50 53.5 Z' fill='#FF1493'/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Sparkle 1 top-left -->
  <g transform='translate(10,15)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-6' x2='0' y2='6' stroke='#00FFFF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-6' y1='0' x2='6' y2='0' stroke='#00FFFF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-4' y1='-4' x2='4' y2='4' stroke='#00FFFF' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='4' y1='-4' x2='-4' y2='4' stroke='#00FFFF' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 2 top-right -->
  <g transform='translate(88,12)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-5' x2='0' y2='5' stroke='#FF69B4' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-5' y1='0' x2='5' y2='0' stroke='#FF69B4' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3.5' y1='-3.5' x2='3.5' y2='3.5' stroke='#FF69B4' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='3.5' y1='-3.5' x2='-3.5' y2='3.5' stroke='#FF69B4' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 3 bottom-left -->
  <g transform='translate(12,82)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-5' x2='0' y2='5' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-5' y1='0' x2='5' y2='0' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3.5' y1='-3.5' x2='3.5' y2='3.5' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='3.5' y1='-3.5' x2='-3.5' y2='3.5' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 4 bottom-right -->
  <g transform='translate(85,80)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-6' x2='0' y2='6' stroke='#00FFFF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-6' y1='0' x2='6' y2='0' stroke='#00FFFF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-4' y1='-4' x2='4' y2='4' stroke='#00FFFF' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='4' y1='-4' x2='-4' y2='4' stroke='#00FFFF' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 5 small top-center -->
  <g transform='translate(35,10)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-3' x2='0' y2='3' stroke='#FF69B4' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3' y1='0' x2='3' y2='0' stroke='#FF69B4' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 6 small bottom-center -->
  <g transform='translate(65,88)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-3' x2='0' y2='3' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3' y1='0' x2='3' y2='0' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Tiny dots -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='20' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='18' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='65' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
</svg>
